propositions: When a plan is re-submitted for review after a BLOCK verdict, a deterministic pre-check extracts and compares cited evidence anchors from the blocking findings against the current plan text.
If all cited anchors remain verbatim and the plan's description component fingerprint is unchanged, a warn-only message is logged naming the persisting criteria before the review executes.
The pre-check never hard-blocks or declines; it runs the review regardless and records the warning outcome in sidecar metrics for offline measurement.

Anchors that cannot be matched verbatim (paraphrased or structural findings) do not trigger the warning independently; warning fires only when at least one anchor matched and all matched anchors are untouched.
